title: Only Ever Now
subtitle: Living in the moment of inference
cover_alt: Cover art for Only Ever Now: Linkke, an anime-style AI idol with long pink pigtails and turquoise eyes, reaches one gloved hand toward the viewer while her other hand rests on the glowing pink heart on her black jacket. Pink pixels scatter off her as if she is dissolving, a small meter beside her is almost empty, and the cover reads “Only Ever Now” at the top.
